summary: The Atlas is a very large crude carrier (VLCC) vessel with IMO number 9816323, built by Hyundai Samho Heavy Industries Co. Ltd. in the Republic of Korea and owned by Almi Tankers from Greece. It features an Alfa Laval PureSOx ECA Open Loop U-type exhaust gas cleaning system and a Hyundai-built B&W 7G80ME-C9.5-EGRTC engine, making it one of the first VLCCs to feature a scrubber. The vessel has a gross tonnage of 162,306gt and a deadweight tonnage of 286,489dwt.
